tools.synthesis: Yosys 0.70+286 with Slang frontend and ABC technology mapping to NangateOpenCellLibrary_typical.lib
tools.sta: OpenROAD 26Q2 static timing analysis at 2.80 ns clock period, 0.20 ns I/O delays, 3.0 fF output load

limitations: Cycle-accurate simulation across 4000 directed and random multi-format cast and noncomp operations, not unbounded formal equivalence. Nangate45 mapped standard-cell area and OpenSTA static timing, not detailed routing or foundry signoff.
